# Repository AI Instructions

## Primary language

English is the required language for all repository content created or modified by AI assistants.

This rule applies to:

- source code identifiers, comments, docstrings, log messages, and error messages;
- configuration files, scripts, tests, examples, and sample data;
- documentation, diagrams, labels, and repository metadata;
- commit messages, branch names, pull request titles, and pull request descriptions.

User-facing text in the repository must also be English unless a task explicitly requires localization or another language as a product feature. Conversations with users may follow the user's language, but repository changes must remain in English.

When modifying an existing file, translate non-English text in the touched area when doing so is safe and relevant. Do not create large unrelated translation changes solely to satisfy this rule. Generated files, vendored dependencies, standardized hardware names, and external data may retain their original language when changing them would be incorrect or impractical.
